text: Well, first of all, I want to let you know that the first few days after you install it, it's wonderful. I loved it. I was fascinated because it types so fast, and when you dictate, it formats the text and even adds the correct spelling and punctuation. But after a few days, it's honestly a terrible app. They're trying to force you to buy the pro version, and the pro version is way too expensive. I wouldn't pay the price they're asking.
